classification.official_reason: Formal 02 completed 18 source rounds without a plant semantic arrival. Robot 0 was repeatedly isolated by a controller-order defect before rotate-first could handle TinyNav's fixed reverse request; Robot 1 faithfully executed source history-node revisits that caused substantial backtracking.
classification.basis: The exact controller and receiver logs show 11 Robot 0 LOCAL_PATH_REVERSE_REQUIRED rejections with zero velocity confirmed. Frozen VLM manifests show Robot 1's below-threshold Judgment decisions entering the source history_score_copy first-argmax branch and alternating between old history nodes.

metrics.standard_shortest_path_status: not required for this failed episode's zero SPL contribution

behavior: Robot 0 made normal metric progress during the first two source rounds, then repeatedly stopped when its local controller reported LOCAL_PATH_REVERSE_REQUIRED.
Robot 0 accumulated 11 LOCAL_PATH_REVERSE_REQUIRED rejections in rounds 2, 3, 4, 5, 9, 10, 11, 12, 14, 16 and 17; every rejection confirmed zero velocity and isolated only the failed leg.
Robot 1 remained command-responsive and accumulated 17.902160 m of odometry, but its 2.918764 m net displacement establishes substantial backtracking.
After Robot 1's round-12 LOCAL_GOAL_UNREACHABLE rejection removed prior-goal continuity, below-threshold Judgment decisions selected old shared history nodes in rounds 13 and 15-17.
The source history branch selected history-1, history-1, history-6 and history-1 across those rounds, producing the observed reversals.

robot_0_diagnosis.classification: source-derived engineering diagnosis from exact immutable controller source, controller telemetry and receiver events
robot_0_diagnosis.root_cause: The pinned TinyNav controller maps a behind-body lookahead to fixed reverse velocity and zero yaw. The deployment wrapper evaluated that negative Twist before its rotate-first branch, so it rejected and returned before bounded zero-linear alignment could run.
robot_0_diagnosis.correction: Under the explicitly verified forward-only planner contract, convert a source negative Twist to stable-heading, zero-linear rotate-first alignment; retain fail-closed rejection when heading authority is missing or the local alignment timeout expires.
robot_0_diagnosis.shared_robot_scope: the same controller overlay is used by both Robot 0 and Robot 1

robot_1_diagnosis.classification: source-derived source-policy behavior from frozen VLM manifests and observed navigation feedback
robot_1_diagnosis.source_behavior: After source step 125, Judgment Yes below 0.5 executes Final_PR = history_score_copy and first-argmax selection. A history node is removed only from the same-round sequential copy, with no persistent revisit cooldown or two-cycle suppression.
robot_1_diagnosis.policy_change_status: not changed; suppressing repeated history revisits would be an explicit deployment divergence from the immutable source behavior
